gen-fredoka-plus-jakarta-sans: Plus Jakarta Sans is a plain sans, modern and precise, keeping its curve endings well apart. And Fredoka's friendly, uniform-width line, with its open e, belongs in oversized headings of just a word or two.
gen-fredoka-switzer: Switzer reads wiry and approachable, a sans-serif with a high lowercase and c tips held well apart. But Fredoka is the one for friendly display, its single-width line and open e, while Switzer handles the body text.
gen-fs-array-fs-bespoke-slab: Array's large lowercase eyes give the headline its futuristic edge. Give Bespoke Slab, grounded and refined, a modest size; its lowercase bodies are generous, so a couple of lines is plenty.
gen-fs-array-fs-hoover: Hoover is a refined, robust serif whose e has a generous entry and whose ascenders run compressed. And Array's open-ended curves and large lowercase eyes lend the pair a futuristic precision, best enjoyed in light reading.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-asap: Technical and functional, Azeret Mono spaces its fixed-width letters generously. Asap's c forms are open arcs and its body height nearly matches the capitals, so running text moves along smoothly.
gen-fs-azeret-mono-fs-epilogue: Fixed-width and code-flavored: that's Azeret Mono, with generous tracking opening every word. And Epilogue, a sans with curvy, approachable letters and stubby ascender tips, loosens that technical rigidity without losing the wiry line.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-fs-gambetta: Bespoke Stencil is commanding and industrial, a plainly built display face best kept to short bursts. Gambetta, bookish and graceful, runs wide channels into each counter and shifts its stroke weight gently, so extended reading flows comfortably.
gen-fs-bespoke-stencil-lora: Commanding and industrial, Bespoke Stencil is plain in build and suited to a line or two. Lora, literary and bookish, thins its curves modestly and gives its c a broad, welcoming opening, which handles the longer reading.
gen-fs-bevellier-fs-bespoke-slab: Flat, stencil-cut and tightly spaced, Bevellier is a display face with a high, wide-looking lowercase. Bespoke Slab, grounded and refined, settles in over a page of text, though it's most restful in modest amounts.
gen-fs-chubbo-fs-sentient: Marker-tip letters with smooth, unobstructed bends give Chubbo a casual, inviting face. But what stands out is open against closed, Chubbo's wide bends against Sentient's pinched apertures and thinner crossbars.
